item.title: Ongoing Fly-Tipping and Vermin Concern, 13th August
item.description:
I would like to report a serious and ongoing fly-tipping problem in the area. The amount of dumped waste appears to be continually increasing, with household rubbish, black bags, garden waste, furniture and other discarded items accumulating along the roadside and surrounding vegetation. The volume of waste is not only unsightly but is also creating a potential public health and environmental concern. The accumulation of rubbish is likely to attract rats, mice, foxes and other vermin, particularly as some of the waste may contain food or other materials that can provide a source of food and shelter. The situation is becoming increasingly unacceptable for local residents and is having a negative impact on the appearance and cleanliness of the area. I would be grateful if the Council could investigate this location, arrange for the waste to be removed and consider whether further action can be taken to prevent continued fly-tipping. I have attached photographs showing the current extent of the problem and would appreciate this being treated as an ongoing environmental and vermin concern.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Waterside Close, Thamesmead
Report on FixMyStreet
